image_description: A top-down view of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) positioned on a textured, dark green mossy or rocky surface. The crab features a broad, oval-shaped carapace with a purplish-brown to reddish hue and lighter mottling. It has robust claws with dark tips and several visible walking legs extending laterally. The lighting appears natural, casting soft shadows beneath the crab's body.
